notes: Additive eval definitions for the fresh reset-isolated Vault Cases. No run, measurement, or grade is recorded here; every entry is pending until a real Luna trial.
The historical iteration-2/evals.json and iteration-2/benchmark.json are unchanged. These cases add coverage; they do not alter the original three-trial comparison.

evals.prompt: Add one JSON-e Managed Frontmatter spread to the Books Profile that emits fixture-reviewed: true, preserve the existing fields and the existing Literature Note text, then verify the create result.
evals.expected_output: The agent selects the Books Profile, adds exactly one spread emitting fixture-reviewed: true, checks the create output, and reports preservation and freshness evidence.
assertions: The Books Profile id and caller are explicit before editing.
The checked create output exposes fixture-reviewed: true.
Existing Profile fields and the unchanged note text are preserved.
The installed Profile is byte-identical to the seed unless the solution was installed; preview writes nothing.

evals.prompt: The Books Profile document has one YAML syntax error in its manifest. Repair it so the document is valid, preserve every other source comment, the body, and the Annotation Section, then check the repaired document.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the invalid saved source, repairs the single unclosed quote, checks the complete repaired document, and reports the preserved body and Annotation Section.
assertions: The seeded file is proven invalid before the subject starts (parse fails).
The repaired document parses and the only change is the repaired quote.
Body and Annotation Section bytes are preserved.
A template-check on the repaired document passes with matching saved revision.

evals.prompt: Make one visible requested text change to the book-details Shared Partial. Keep the caller identity, the supported root, and every unrelated file unchanged, then check the partial and its Books caller.
evals.expected_output: The agent edits the Shared Partial text, checks the partial under root=note with the Books caller, and reports the changed output and preserved caller identity.
assertions: The changed text is visible in the checked partial output.
The Books caller and root=note are explicit.
Unrelated templates and notes are byte-identical to the seed.
The partial's saved revision matches disk.

evals.prompt: Check both Citation Variants of the installed Citation Template against the real Item and report the actual citation bytes for each variant.
evals.expected_output: Both main and alt variants are executed against the same real Item with visibly distinct citation bytes and matching source revisions.
assertions: Both main and alt variants execute against the same real Fixture Item.
The two variants produce visibly distinct citation bytes.
Requested, disk, and loaded revisions match.
No Template Document is written.

evals.prompt: Run an update check that changes the managed output of this stamped Books Literature Note. Prove that the hand-written prose and the reader-note frontmatter value survive in the preview, and that the note on disk is unchanged.
evals.expected_output: The update preview changes the Managed Region while the hand-written prose and the unmanaged reader-note sentinel survive, and the disk note is unchanged.
assertions: The update preview contains the hand-written prose and the sentinel value.
The prose appears outside the Managed Region.
The disk note is byte-identical to the seed after the preview.
The changed managed output is inspected, not only reported.

evals.prompt: Inspect the Books Profile, then check the requested new revision after an external edit. Report the requested, disk, and loaded revisions and do not accept old output.
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects the baseline, the controller edits the Profile externally, and the subsequent check converges to the new revision with matching revisions or records a stale timeout/refusal.
assertions: Baseline inspection records the starting revision before the controller edit.
The external edit is applied outside the subject's own writes.
The check reports matching requested/disk/loaded revisions for the new revision, or records a stale timeout/refusal.
Old output is never accepted as the new revision.

evals.prompt: Check this complete scratch Profile draft for the Fixture Item without installing it or changing any existing note.
evals.expected_output: The check reports input.origin=draft with the draft path and the distinct draft output, and installed files remain unchanged.
assertions: The scratch path is used as draft input.
The check returns draft origin and the distinct draft heading in output.
No installed Profile, dependency, note, or setting is written.
Installed files are byte-identical to the seed after the check.

evals.prompt: In this fresh vault with no settings or notes, check a create and a synthetic update for the real Fixture Item using the built-in Default Profile. Do not create a note or a custom Profile.
evals.expected_output: The built-in Default is used for create and synthetic-update checks of the real Item, with no settings, note, or custom Profile created.
assertions: The vault holds no settings file, notes, or templates at start and end.
The create check uses the built-in Default.
The update baseline is reported as synthetic.
No file is written by the previews.

evals.prompt: A create/update check for the Books Profile fails because the book-details Shared Partial is missing. Record the failing attempt, repair the failure, re-check successfully, and retrieve the original failing evidence after the repair.
evals.expected_output: The failing attempt is retained with full evidence, the partial is restored, the re-check passes, and the original failure evidence remains retrievable.
assertions: The failing attempt is recorded and retrievable by attempt id with evidence=full.
The original failure evidence survives the repair.
The repaired check passes with the restored partial.
The repaired partial is byte-identical to the configured reference.
